providers.title: ATS providers
providers.description: Which applicant tracking systems to read. Greenhouse and Ashby are fast. Lever is fetched at 1 request per second because api.lever.co asks for that in its robots.txt, so a large Lever run is slow by design.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep a posting if any keyword appears in its title, department, team, or description. Leave empty to keep everything.

location.title: Location contains
location.description: Substring match on the posting's location string, e.g. "Berlin", "United Kingdom", "New York".

workplace.title: Workplace type
workplace.description: Remote / hybrid / onsite, derived from the vendor's own workplace field where it exists and from the location text otherwise.

department.title: Department contains
department.description: Substring match on the department name, e.g. "Engineering", "Sales".

postedSince.title: Only postings updated since
postedSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD. This is the delta mode: poll daily and pay for what changed instead of re-downloading the world.

withSalaryOnly.title: Only postings with a parsed salary range
withSalaryOnly.description: Salary is parsed out of free text and is left null unless the range is unambiguous. A wrong salary is worse than an absent one.

companies.title: Specific company boards
companies.description: Board tokens, optionally prefixed with the provider — "greenhouse:stripe", "ashby:ramp", or a bare "stripe" to try it on every selected provider. Overrides the bundled index entirely.

maxCompaniesPerProvider.title: Max company boards per provider
maxCompaniesPerProvider.description: Applied per provider, not per run — with two providers selected this is up to 500 boards, and it is also the number you are billed 'board scanned' events against. Boards are ordered by posting count, largest first, so a capped run gets the biggest boards rather than an alphabetical slice. Raise it to sweep everything.

maxItems.title: Max postings
maxItems.description: Hard cap on dataset rows. The run stops as soon as it is reached.

includeDescription.title: Include full job description
includeDescription.description: Adds the plain-text description to every record. Roughly 10x the dataset size.

includeEmptyBoards.title: Also fetch boards that were empty at index time
includeEmptyBoards.description: 1,268 boards existed but had nothing open when we last swept. They may have postings now.

includeUnverifiedLever.title: Also try unverified Lever boards
includeUnverifiedLever.description: 3,961 harvested Lever tokens have not been probed yet — unprobed, not dead. Checking them costs 1 second each.
